method: Existing 42-feature denominator; complete=1, partial/blocking-regression=0.5, absent=0. Equal planning weights, not effort, predictive success or demo success probability. Shared console regression counted under U01/U02, not multiplied into every downstream feature.

features.feature: Refresh source history, universe and model inputs
features.assessment: NSE acquisition, universe re-flagging and rebuilt prediction snapshot are now connected. Read-only DB census reaches 2026-10-19; 54 acquisition tests passed, one live-source test skipped.
features.prior_acceptance: A supplied real data interval produces dated, aligned model inputs; re-running does not duplicate records.

features.feature: Hawkes pillar calculation and inspectable diagnostics
features.assessment: Original count/kernel estimators, fitted artifacts and archive diagnostics are connected. No new feature work for this unit; live scheduling and sector/network outputs are separate rows.
features.prior_acceptance: Inspect a real archived Hawkes result and its model/input provenance.

features.feature: RMT pillar calculation and inspectable diagnostics
features.assessment: Spectral estimator and state adapter execute; archived spectral outputs reach the console. Prediction quality is separate; no need to retune to complete this unit.
features.prior_acceptance: Inspect real spectrum/state diagnostics on a dated result.

features.feature: Hamilton pillar calculation and inspectable regimes
features.assessment: Original TVTP model, causal research route and Astra variant exist; diagnostics are displayed with eligibility caveats. An excluded or scientifically inadequate estimate is not an absent implementation; preserve its exclusion.
features.prior_acceptance: Show an actual fitted/archived regime result and the stated eligibility limitation.

features.feature: Reconciliation, composite score, uncertainty and attribution
features.assessment: C8/C9 execute on archive inputs; masks, timestamps, score/variance and Shapley outputs are connected. No requirement to prove predictive skill or recalibrate thresholds for engineering credit.
features.prior_acceptance: Selected historical input produces persisted score, uncertainty and attribution with missingness visible.

features.feature: Historical end-to-end replay and durable results
features.assessment: Archive replay saves sealed runs and reports; two complete canonical runs/162 points were read during this audit. No expensive rerun needed; saved archive is not fresh live execution.
features.prior_acceptance: Select/reopen the saved run and its dated results.

features.feature: Market tick/bar runtime with restart recovery
features.assessment: Feed/bar/session/runtime components exist; recent integrity fixes and recorded crash recovery cover three crash points. Actual publisher/broker access and live producer connection remain separate requirements.
features.prior_acceptance: Recorded real runtime-path recovery evidence preserves bars/decision identity across restart.

features.feature: Fresh market inputs through real pillars to current dashboard risk
features.assessment: Daily producers and recent registry repair exist, but recorded runtime has only one withheld historical replay; intraday_bars is empty, original Hamilton excluded, main console remains archive-based.
features.prior_acceptance: Through the real producer interfaces, fresh authorised inputs create a persisted current decision and update the full intended risk view; recorded historical verification must be labelled replay.

features.feature: Historical future-loss forecasts and baseline comparison
features.assessment: Walk-forward predictive models, saved probabilities, event/false-alarm metrics and research viewer are implemented. Forecast quality may be poor without making this feature absent.
features.prior_acceptance: Inspect actual out-of-sample saved forecasts and baseline results with negative findings retained.

features.feature: Ongoing forecast generation and prospective record
features.assessment: Current prediction state reaches 2026-10-19, but durable forecast ledger contains 14 forecasts only for 2026-08-21, first issued 2026-10-19. run_forecast publishes saved experiment rows, not the newly computed operational forecast.
features.prior_acceptance: One newly available input date creates an identified forecast record and visible result; retry does not duplicate it or use unmatured outcome labels.

features.feature: Inspect existing evaluation and retrospective reports
features.assessment: Saved research reports, backtest view, baseline comparison and hazard-watch evidence are accessible. This credit does not imply original-spec full ablations/cross-market completion or positive performance.
features.prior_acceptance: Open actual report, see method/input scope, scores and limitations.

features.feature: Complete original evaluation experiment runner
features.assessment: Experiment, transfer, sensitivity and archive runner plus evaluation UI are connected and tested. This credits engineering machinery; real full-epoch results and Table C public contract remain unavailable.
features.prior_acceptance: One command exposes the fixed configurations, runs eligible supplied inputs and saves labelled results/unavailable reasons. Outcome quality is not a pass condition; expensive full scientific evaluation can be deferred.

features.feature: Measured Hawkes sector micro-flags
features.assessment: sector_flags helper and transport types exist. Fresh/source producer does not supply sector histories/baselines; archive coverage explicitly says unavailable.
features.prior_acceptance: A supported measured/replayed sector input yields a dated micro-flag that reaches the UI and portfolio overlay.

features.feature: Measured directed market contagion network
features.assessment: Network fields/readers/rendering contracts exist. No connected network-estimation producer; Hawkes branching_matrix is empty. News exposure arcs are a different feature.
features.prior_acceptance: Using an explicitly defined, approved estimator and sufficient input, display actual directed links with dates and provenance; do not infer institution balance sheets from prices.

features.feature: Ordinary project launch orchestrates market refresh as well as news
features.assessment: Launcher starts market jobs and news. OS daily task is registered and enabled. Acquisition now precedes daily vintages and prediction.
features.prior_acceptance: One normal launcher starts required configured services, shows clear unavailable dependencies, updates data/decisions without a second terminal and stops owned services.

features.feature: Original console, 3D globe shell and three role views
features.assessment: Implemented console and role machinery has a demonstrated blocking browser regression: history.forEach is not a function prevents the saved-run payload from replacing the preview.
features.prior_acceptance: Switch roles and show their permitted real fields without replacing the original frontend.

features.feature: Historical run/date risk dashboard
features.assessment: Persisted historical runs exist, but the real browser cannot complete rendering their payload due to the history object/list mismatch.
features.prior_acceptance: Change date/run and see coherent actual results.

features.feature: Official Nifty 500 benchmark overlay
features.assessment: Official benchmark loader and dated backend join exist. Frontend has no benchmark renderer and still expects an array, crashing on the new history object.
features.prior_acceptance: Display actual benchmark returns and CSRS on aligned dates; name series/source and show genuine gaps.

features.feature: Enter holdings and calculate portfolio value/coverage
features.assessment: JSON holdings submission and coverage arithmetic work. Persistence and measured-sector linkage are separate units.
features.prior_acceptance: Submit supplied holdings and view labelled value weights/unmapped coverage.

features.feature: Persistent portfolios, upload preview, history and watchlists
features.assessment: MY WORKSPACE connects dated portfolio import, validation, persistence, history and watchlists. Dispatcher and UI tests pass; no shared-user authentication claim.
features.prior_acceptance: Upload CSV/JSON, preview errors, save/select/reopen holdings and a watchlist after restart under an explicit local demo identity.

features.feature: Measured portfolio sector-risk overlay
features.assessment: Coverage-aware overlay calculation is implemented. Canonical dispatch passes empty sector flags; news relevance does not satisfy measured pillar-risk linkage.
features.prior_acceptance: A real dated sector flag changes the relevant holding's flagged share; unknown positions remain unknown.

features.feature: Market-level FII/DII and residual flow display
features.assessment: One dated real flow record is readable by market_flow and passed in payload.flow, but bridge.js tools still renders fabricated example values and never reads payload.flow.
features.prior_acceptance: Show one real dated flow record and proxy definition; no claim of identifying retail counterparties.

features.feature: Single-pillar shock sensitivity tool
features.assessment: Form invokes the actual simulator/C9 and shows a hypothetical score path. No need to turn a rank shock into an economic forecast.
features.prior_acceptance: Enter baseline/changed shock and view the response with the hypothetical label.

features.feature: Save, compare, review and export market scenarios
features.assessment: Scenario save/run/compare/review/export dispatcher and Streamlit workspace controls are connected; downloads exist.
features.prior_acceptance: Save a named shock scenario, run it, compare to baseline, review the exact revision, export and reopen after restart.

features.feature: Macro/policy covariate-path simulation
features.assessment: Direct regime-path simulator works; fitted z-to-xi projector exists. UI accepts xi_path only, not a macro z path tied to a fitted artifact.
features.prior_acceptance: Use an available permitted fitted artifact and declared covariates to compare baseline/scenario; do not invent coefficients or require a desired risk direction.

features.feature: Retrospective defensive-action drawdown comparison
features.assessment: Dominant-pillar advice card exists. Measured strategy comparison absent; drawdownReductionPct remains None. Requires declared positions, execution/cost assumptions and data.
features.prior_acceptance: Calculate and display a bounded historical baseline/action comparison under explicit assumptions; improvement is not mandatory.

features.feature: Durable regulator alert-action journal
features.assessment: Create/update/retract actions persist against an alert and its decomposition. Case management is a separate feature; no real trading/circuit-breaker execution is implied.
features.prior_acceptance: Create/reopen an annotation under the local demo identity.

features.feature: Regulator case lifecycle and evidence export
features.assessment: Regulator case lifecycle, pinned evidence and download controls are connected in the Streamlit workspace.
features.prior_acceptance: Create a case from an alert, attach evidence, record a decision, close/reopen and export; persist across restart.

features.feature: Institution-level exposure decomposition
features.assessment: Role field/preview slot exists; institutionDecomposition is None. No real submission/import-to-decomposition journey. Market/news data do not establish private institution positions.
features.prior_acceptance: Accept authorised user-supplied exposures through a documented schema and show their evidenced aggregation; synthetic examples must remain labelled scenarios.

features.feature: Installable canonical frontend and runtime resources
features.assessment: Actual installed-wheel check passes: component assets, curated registries, migrations and schema load outside checkout. Do not redo closed packaging repair; later changes need proportionate verification.
features.prior_acceptance: Use the existing installed-wheel evidence; preserve the working package declarations.

features.feature: Automatic news startup and owned shutdown
features.assessment: Canonical launcher and app start one supervised worker; no separate news command. Do not reimplement this closed item. Bare Streamlit starts on first page execution; canonical launcher starts before page attachment.
features.prior_acceptance: Saved rehearsal starts services through normal app and records zero owned news processes after shutdown.

features.feature: Polling, manual refresh, freshness and source failure isolation
features.assessment: Worker uses degraded source state while healthy feeds continue; manual acquisition is serviced. No production uptime campaign required.
features.prior_acceptance: Saved rehearsal covers two passes, manual fetch results and a failing source with 18 healthy sources remaining covered.

features.feature: Real multi-source aggregation
features.assessment: 19 registered sources in current store; feed/document adapters, registration and source health work. Specific blocked/unsupported publishers remain coverage limits, not an absent aggregation feature.
features.prior_acceptance: Show actual sourced articles and individual source status; fixed historical documents labelled as such.

features.feature: Substantive document extraction and structured interpretation
features.assessment: Permitted full document route, scopes, legal stages, quantities and evidence provenance implemented. Universal OCR, table reasoning, Hindi comprehension and validated accuracy are not claimed.
features.prior_acceptance: Show extracted fields with their actual source text/scope and abstentions.

features.feature: Qualitative sector/exposure impact inference
features.assessment: Documented routes produce direction/mechanism/confidence and unknown exposure. Financial magnitudes and comprehensive exposure coverage remain unknown; not a reason to rebuild working qualitative inference.
features.prior_acceptance: Inspect one domestic and one foreign-to-India route with citations and explicit qualitative labels.

features.feature: News markers, documented globe paths and clickable evidence
features.assessment: Original globe has real news markers/paths; saved rehearsal shows 7 markers and 1 arc. No fabricated extra arc to fill empty geography.
features.prior_acceptance: Click through a real marker and its relationship evidence.

features.feature: Retail holdings news relevance
features.assessment: Matched holdings and unmapped holdings are separately shown; weights are not loss estimates. Durable holdings workspace is U05, not an unfinished news-matching function.
features.prior_acceptance: Existing browser evidence shows TATASTEEL relevance and explicit unmapped holding.

features.feature: Institutional product-country exposure matrix
features.assessment: Documented pairs render as explicitly unsized cells. Do not inflate coverage by counting product aliases as independent exposures.
features.prior_acceptance: Matrix displays actual documented relationships and unknown sizes.

features.feature: Cited instrument comparison
features.assessment: Pair selection calls comparison, returns field differences and evidence to the visible result. Presentation is raw JSON rather than polished side-by-side cards. Count as implemented under the user's functional-demo criterion; formatting is OPTIONAL.
features.prior_acceptance: Select a real comparable pair and inspect differences/evidence; direct code path is traced, latest browser only confirms control offered.

features.feature: Usable conditional numerical tariff scenario
features.assessment: Scenario arithmetic and assumptions form exist; documented real-data examples lack supported rate/applicability inputs for a usable priced example. No fresh successful numerical browser demonstration established.
features.prior_acceptance: One real supported measure plus labelled user cost assumptions produces conditional arithmetic, or keep this explicitly input-blocked. Never assume missing old rate is zero.

features.feature: Persisted regulator instrument-link review
features.assessment: Latest browser result records DONE and one stored review with local demo attribution; current projection reads stored decisions. Older failing browser result has been superseded. Do not reopen that repaired exception.
features.prior_acceptance: Latest artifact proves UI submission and stored record; reload/projection behavior also has a traced code path, not a claimed fresh browser run here.

features.feature: Download complete displayed news analysis/scenario
features.assessment: Export control sends empty arguments; returned JSON is rendered without a download. Displayed scenario/matrix are not reliably bound into a complete export.
features.prior_acceptance: Download JSON or CSV that includes displayed inputs/result, matrix/comparison where selected, evidence, as-of and limitations; reopen file and compare to screen.
